fields.statement: When the run's change set has already landed, as a milestone plan's record does after the interview, rhiza run review-check puts each question it leaves into the open plan change set that created the finding's node, or lands it with a record write when that node has landed too; while the run's change set is open the questions go there.
fields.wording: the building agent's choice while building leaf plan-review-rounds, following plan-record-lands-early
